investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Verdfold Media (news and media publishing); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west1 (zones europe-west1-b/europe-west1-c/europe-west1-d); network range 10.225.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster verdfo-prod-europe (GKE); Edge: two nginx load balancers (lb-01, lb-02) behind DNS round-robin terminate client connections for web-frontend; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
